hits_and_misses.pass1_miss: Marked 'Ready (P1)' & 'Self-serve Trial'. The agent read marketing copy ('Request a Demo / Start Exploring') and assumed a standard SaaS self-serve signup flow.
hits_and_misses.verification_loop: Loop 2 (Contradiction & Pricing Audit): Checked signup endpoints; found no public self-registration. Identified enterprise Intapp gating requiring sales contract.
hits_and_misses.final_truth: Blocked (P3 - Partner/Sales Gate). Strict enterprise portal; zero self-serve testing without institutional agreement.
hits_and_misses.ops_lesson: B2B financial SaaS frequently uses marketing trial buttons that actually lead to sales BDR qualification forms. Heuristic rule must check for live self-registration URL.

hits_and_misses.pass1_miss: Marked 'Ready (P0 - Immediate Quick Win)'. Agent noted Meta Cloud API has free test numbers and assumed zero friction for agent workflows.
hits_and_misses.verification_loop: Loop 1 (Policy & Auth Scrutiny): Analyzed documentation on live message delivery; discovered 24hr session window and mandatory Meta Business Verification & message template pre-approval.
hits_and_misses.final_truth: Conditional (P2 - Verification Gated for Production). Quick to prototype on sandbox, but production customer outreach is strictly gated by Meta compliance.
hits_and_misses.ops_lesson: Distinguish between Sandbox Developer Viability vs Production Scalability. Composio toolkits must guide users through Meta verification steps.

hits_and_misses.pass1_miss: Marked 'Self-serve Free'. Agent conflated standard Salesforce Developer Edition orgs (which are 100% free forever) with Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Demandware).
hits_and_misses.verification_loop: Loop 2 (URL & Product Boundary Check): Crawled Commerce Cloud documentation; detected requirement for On-Demand Sandboxes (ODS) and Account Manager credentials.
hits_and_misses.final_truth: Blocked (P3 - Partner/Sales Gate). Requires separate enterprise contract and provisioned ODS credits; entirely distinct from core Salesforce CRM orgs.
hits_and_misses.ops_lesson: Platform umbrella brands (Salesforce, Adobe, Microsoft) require product-specific isolation in agent scrapers to prevent inherited assumptions.

hits_and_misses.pass1_miss: Marked 'Ready (P0)'. Scraper found API references and swagger docs, hallucinating an open API key generation flow.
hits_and_misses.verification_loop: Loop 3 (Sales Wall & Pricing Checker): Scanned PitchBook pricing and developer terms; identified ~$25k+/year enterprise contract requirement and complete absence of self-serve keys.
hits_and_misses.final_truth: Blocked (P3 - Partner/Sales Gate). High financial barrier; requires enterprise institutional contract with PitchBook / Morningstar.
hits_and_misses.ops_lesson: Open documentation does NOT equal open access. Many enterprise vendors publish OpenAPI specs publicly for marketing SEO while locking tokens behind sales contracts.

hits_and_misses.pass1_miss: Marked 'Ready (P0) with Public REST API'. Agent indexed community GitHub repositories wrapping Otter and assumed an official developer REST API existed.
hits_and_misses.verification_loop: Loop 1 (Official Docs Audit): Crawled help.otter.ai and detected zero official developer REST documentation; confirmed community tools use reverse-engineered session cookies.
hits_and_misses.final_truth: Workaround (P3 - Unofficial / Session Token). No official public developer REST API; agent integrations require browser session cookies or unofficial webhooks.
hits_and_misses.ops_lesson: Always cross-check third-party SDK claims against the vendor's primary documentation domain (help.otter.ai vs github.com). Unofficial APIs introduce high churn risk.

hits_and_misses.pass1_miss: Marked 'Ready (P1)'. Model assumed a standard REST API /api/v1 exists based on general SaaS conventions.
hits_and_misses.verification_loop: Loop 1 (404 & robots.txt crawler): Attempted URL resolution of developer subdomains (api.fanbasis.com, docs.fanbasis.com); found zero developer pages or documentation.
hits_and_misses.final_truth: Blocked (P3 - No Public API). Consumer VIP fan interaction site without a public developer API surface.
hits_and_misses.ops_lesson: Negative space detection: if an automated crawler cannot locate a developer portal or API documentation within 2 hops from the root domain, classify as No Public API.
